snippet.text: under the same hypotheses, with `r := Real.sqrt (2 * radialEnergy w.2)`: `0 < r ∧ D w = (LocalHeatFormula.amplitude C h (1 - w.1) r / r) • BaseResidual.angularVector w ∧ p w = -(∫ ρ in Ioi r, LocalHeatFormula.amplitude C h (1 - w.1) ρ ^ 2 / ρ) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun ρ => amplitude C h (1 - w.1) ρ ^ 2 / ρ) (Ioi r)`
